claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Papaverine at 2.5 uM is a weak, non-selective PDE inhibitor and vasodilator that is unlikely to produce a class-specific killing pattern; any modest antiproliferative effect would most plausibly reflect a cationic amphiphilic/lysosomotropic or general cytotoxic effect rather than PDE inhibition.
